description: OECD AI Paper No. 59 — the 10 AI capability domains mapped against occupational requirements (language, social interaction, problem solving, creativity, metacognition, knowledge, learning/memory, vision, manipulation, robotic intelligence). Creativity is the direct entry-point for Atana cultural analysis.
notes: Domain definitions from the OECD AI Capability Indicators framework. atana_relevance column carries the cultural-occupation entry-point for each domain.
